title: Get Samples
description: Get all samples in the system or details about specific ones. You can also search by hashes

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Sample ID, hash or type, leave blank if 'all' is selected

optional_params.title: Optional Parameters
optional_params.description: Parameters that allow finer tuning of the Get Samples action, e.g {"analysis_id": 12345}

title: Dirname
description: Get the directory name of a path

title: List User
description: Show a paginated list of all users. Users can be filtered by their IDs or email

ids.title: IDs
ids.description: Filter by user IDs. IDs should be a comma separated list

user_list.title: User List
user_list.description: List of users that meet the filter criteria

title: Show User
description: Returns a single user, identified by ID

user_found.title: User Found
user_found.description: Returns true if user with specified ID found

title: Add Permission Set to User
description: Adds permission set(s) to specified user

permission_set.title: Permission Set
permission_set.description: String name of the permission set to apply

title: Assign Tags
description: Assigns the given tag to an agent by GUID, name, IP address, MAC address or user name

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Agent GUID, name, IP address, MAC address or user name

title: Clear Tags
description: Clears the given tag to an agent by GUID, name, IP address, MAC address or user name

device.title: Device
device.description: Agent GUID, name, IP address, MAC address or user name

title: Search Agents
description: Find Systems in the ePolicy Orchestrator tree by name, IP address, MAC address, user name, AgentGUID, or tag

query.title: Query
query.description: Name, IP address, MAC address, user name, AgentGUID, or tag to search available agents

title: Get Policies
description: Get policies assigned to a user

search_text.title: Search Text
search_text.description: Finds all policies that the user is permitted to see that match the given search text

policies_returned.title: Policies Returned
policies_returned.description: All policies that match to the given search text

title: Wake Up
description: Wakes up the agent on a system

system_name.title: System Name
system_name.description: Name of an system to wake up

title: Get Task History
description: Get task history

team.title: Team
team.description: Leave this field blank to get your history or specify to get team history

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Limits number of records, Size range 1-100

title: Get Report
description: Get task report

title: Split String to Object
description:
This action is used to convert a string to an object containing key:value strings.

Any input requiring more than a single key:value pair, e.g. `USER=Bob` needs to use the `block_delimiter` option. In this case, the input string is split by the `block_delimiter` character first, and the resulting items are then split by the `string_delimiter` option. Stripping of double-quotes is automatically applied in this situation for each item before the plugin returns it.

The [output object](https://docs.komand.com/v0.42.1/docs/python-script-plugins#section-configure-the-plugin-output-schema) on the action's page can be modified to pre-populate the workflow with the names of the keys. It allows users the ability to use the green selector and choose a specific variable later in the workflow by name. [Input templating](https://docs.komand.com/docs/input-templating) would need to be used to obtain variables by name otherwise.

Please refer to troubleshooting section for a more complex example
